_about: The source of this book's PDF and EPUB (scripts/build-book-files.mjs). The folder is named by the book's id, its folder under client/public/ebook/, which a rename never changes; the title and subtitle come from client/src/data/book-names.json. The sec*.xhtml files are the author's text, taken unchanged from the original EPUB kept in content/held-downloads/originals/: one block to a line. Correct the text there, change `modified`, and run `node scripts/build-book-files.mjs the-monster-in-the-mirror --verify`. `copyright` is the notice as the original PDF printed it, without its unfilled ISBN line.
